name: Marshal's Anthem
clause: When ~ enters, return up to X target creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield, where X is the number of times ~ was kicked.

needs.proposedSignature: Amount { count: 'times-kicked' } backed by GameObject.castWith.timesKicked: number, and a cast action that may pay the kicker cost any number of times (cost.ts spellManaCost taking a kick count instead of a boolean)
needs.semantics: CR 702.33b: multikicker may be paid any number of times and cards count the payments ('a +1/+1 counter for each time it was kicked', 'X is the number of times it was kicked'). The engine's kicker is a boolean, so every such magnitude collapses to 1 and cannot be written honestly.
needs.clause: ~ enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each time it was kicked. / where X is the number of times ~ was kicked.
